summary: Xiaomi's MiMo API pricing page marks its TTS series as limited-time free in both the domestic and overseas pricing sections: mimo-v2.5-tts, mimo-v2.5-tts-voiceclone (voice cloning) and mimo-v2.5-tts-voicedesign (voice design). No end date is given.
